answer_1.quote: For the normal context length task, we choose TruthfulQA (BLEU score) from LM-Eval . We also select several subsets from LongBench, including HotpotQA (F1 score), 2WikiMultihopQA (F1 score), MuSiQue (F1 score), TREC (classification accuracy), TriviaQA (F1 score), SAMSum (Rouge-L) and Passage-Count (Exact match accuracy).

answer_2.quote: We evaluate XQuant on the TruthfulQA task with BLEU score and on LongBench subsets using metrics such as F1 score, classification accuracy, Rouge-L, and Exact match accuracy.
